changes.tests: DC13..DC15 + three actual read-only native cancels

changes.change: Explicit ExperimentSeriesPolicy: five independent <=30 request / <=300 operation scopes, one persistent <=150 request / <=1500 operation umbrella, <=2 concurrent requests, <=7200s global and <=1800s per experiment in host. Single policy limits unchanged.

No automatic peer-message planner or event-triggered inference

findings.cause: Repeated unchanged observation and no explicit local repositioning
